body: Hello i am generacionp today trying to enter the realm I found the surprise of being banned for alleged "Hacks" I have only played once on the server, which has done very well, I would appeal to my ban and I thought to have a future here, please answer some admin and so we can chat, thank you for your attention.

replies.author: Two_Become_One
replies.body:
Hello,

Unfortunately I have decided to deny your appeal.

Reason: Lack of effort  and Video evidence of you using Anti-Knock back.

You may attempt to appeal in a couple of months.

Regards,
Devil_Fruit, Senior Mod.
